_source.IN: Local Government Directory (lgdirectory.gov.in), urban local bodies snapshot of 24 Sep 2026 - every statutory town (municipal corporation, municipality, nagar panchayat / town panchayat). Local-body suffixes removed, officially renamed cities updated (e.g. Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Ahilyanagar, Dharashiv, Sri Vijaya Puram), multi-corporation cities merged (Delhi, Bengaluru), and places LGD has no local body for added (Ahmedabad, Secunderabad, Greater Noida, Vasco da Gama, Bokaro Steel City, Amaravati, Lakshadweep islands, Andaman towns). Same-name towns in one state are qualified with their district.
_source.AE: Cities and towns of each emirate, cross-checked against GeoNames.
_source.short_city_name: IATA code where the city has an airport, otherwise a generated 3-letter code unique within the state.
